title: Onboard umbran-20b v1.0: perf profiles, metadata, and changelog automation
author: Marina Ortega
release_notes: Added umbran-20b v1.0 to the model catalog with verified performance profiles, quantization guidance, and automated changelog generation for future metadata updates.
description: Motivation: Onboard 'umbran-20b' v1.0 into the model registry with complete metadata, versioning, validated performance profiles across supported instance types, and automated changelog/release notes generation integrated into the model-registry pipeline. This PR adds: model metadata (models/umbran/metadata.yaml) with schema fields (license, tokenizer, quantization-recommendations, checksums), performance profiles (models/umbran/perf/profiles.json) generated from benchmark runs (benchmarks/umbran/results.csv), changelog automation script (scripts/auto_changelog/generate_changelog.py) and CI hook (ci/model_registry_pipeline.yaml) to publish release notes on metadata updates, docs (docs/models/umbran.md) and lightweight onboarding checklist. Commits summary: 1) Add umbran metadata and model card; 2) Add perf profiles and benchmarking harness updates; 3) Add changelog generator and CI integration; 4) Fix test expectations and adjust schema validations. Changed areas (high level): models/umbran/metadata.yaml, models/umbran/perf/profiles.json, scripts/auto_changelog/generate_changelog.py, ci/model_registry_pipeline.yaml, docs/models/umbran.md, benchmarks/umbran/run_perf.sh, tests/test_model_metadata.py. Review conversation snapshot: Diego Ramirez requested quantization guidance for A100 and RTX families; Priya Singh requested rolling-window averages instead of single-run values for key metrics; Liam O'Connor asked for a small docs addition and approval once CI is green. Author responses: added quantization_profiles section, included rolling_stats (p50/p90/p99 and tokens/sec) in perf profiles, expanded docs and onboarding checklist, adjusted schema validator to accept new fields. CI summary: initial pipeline hit a flaky benchmark job (timeout) in perf-smoke; benchmark grid was retried and rerun, then all checks passed (unit, lint, perf-smoke, integration). Merge outcome: squashed and merged after approvals; changelog entry auto-generated by scripts/auto_changelog and published to /releases/model-registry. Related work: ENG-4821 (onboarding), PM-108 (product validation), SUP-3291 (customer request). Notes: kept changes minimal in core registry code, focused on data files and a small automation hook; no breaking changes to registry schema, backwards compatible with existing tooling.
